verdict.rationale: The skills CLI installs, lists, updates and removes agent skills, and says it supports non-interactive, CI/CD-friendly runs. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself can schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Running the CLI from an external cron or CI scheduler would be a user-side or host-platform workaround, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
